engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Heater Element for Auxiliary Heater (Z35) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Heater Element for Auxiliary Heater (Z35)
technicalNotes: Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Auxiliary Heater, this Fault Code often cannot be cleared. Usually this Code implies that the Heater Element (Z35) houses the Kontrol Modülü this Fault Code is stored in, therefor the Heater Element may need to be replaced to fix this.
